title: Remove or explicitly justify AppLogger.setupFlutterErrorHandlers — dead code duplicating crashlytics_bootstrap.dart's live handlers

evidence.quote:
final talker = AppLogger.init();
  final log = AppLogger(talker);

why: Grepping every .dart file in the repo shows AppLogger.setupFlutterErrorHandlers is referenced nowhere except its own definition and its 3 unit tests in logger_test.dart. Production's bootstrap chain (bootstrap.dart:40) installs FlutterError.onError/PlatformDispatcher.onError exclusively via bootstrapCrashlyticsHandlers in app/bootstrap/crashlytics_bootstrap.dart — a completely independent implementation of the same responsibility that also forwards to Crashlytics (setupFlutterErrorHandlers only forwards to Talker). A maintainer reading logger_test.dart's 3 green tests would reasonably believe this is the production error-handling path; if some future refactor swaps main.dart's wiring back to this method for 'simplicity', fatal-crash reporting silently stops reaching Crashlytics while Talker logs keep looking healthy, and the existing green test suite would not catch it since it only ever exercises the unused copy.
recommendation: Delete AppLogger.setupFlutterErrorHandlers and its 3 tests, or — if it's meant as a documented fallback for contexts without Crashlytics wired — rename it and add a comment cross-referencing crashlytics_bootstrap.dart so the duplication is intentional and visible rather than accidental drift.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'setupFlutterErrorHandlers' lib/ returns only its own definition, or a caller with a comment explaining the split from crashlytics_bootstrap.dart
No test exercises a code path unreachable from main.dart's actual bootstrap chain

corrections: None — all four cited file:line/quote pairs verified exact; grep confirms no other production callers.

mergedFrom: Delete dead AppLogger.setupFlutterErrorHandlers (logger.dart:85-94) — near-duplicate of the live crashlytics_bootstrap.dart handler wiring
